image_description: A high-angle shot of a steep, light-colored rocky cliff face sloping down towards a deep blue ocean. The rock surface is textured with visible stratification and weathering. Sparse dry vegetation clings to the foreground ledges. The horizon line separates the ocean from a clear blue sky.
